chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fudayla ibn Ayyub, from Isma'il ibn Abi Ziyad, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) kissed Uthman ibn Maz'un after his death.
ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet Muhammad kiss the deceased?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* establishes the permissibility of kissing the deceased, specifically citing the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) kissing Uthman ibn Maz'un after his death. In Shia jurisprudence, this serves as a primary evidence (dalil) for the practice of *qabd al-ruh* or showing affection to the dead, distinguishing it from mere ritual washing, and underscores the emotional bond between the Prophet and his companions even in death.
